title: Playtest fixes: memory, freezes, resolution, people, shadows, signs, fire

items.name: Memory runaway (tab crash): far LOD built and kept for every chunk of the 31 x 45 km world; patch limits far LOD to 9 km and frees beyond 10.5 km (lead applies docs/v2/reports/playtest-fixes-patches/stream-far-radius.patch); heap now levels off in a 7 min soak

Shader recompile storms: point/spot light count changed as lights came and went, recompiling every material (250 programs after load, bursts of 60-70). Light count now constant (src/render/perfGuards.v2.js); 57 new programs after load, all genuinely new materials
GC churn: minimap rebuilt every shop icon every frame (interiors list getter); facade batches in JS double arrays; elevated joints re-sampled per tile build (patch)
WebGL context loss: message, pause, forced restore, reload button (src/render/contextGuard.v2.js)
Native fixed resolution: adaptive scaler removed (it held the canvas at 0.8x: 1536x864 in a 1920x1080 window); canvas always fills the window, DPR up to 2, ResizeObserver + fullscreen
Frame time: 60 fps with no frame over 25 ms on the user's Mac
Quality presets Low/Medium/High/Ultra with auto-pick (schema exists in src/ui/settings, store not wired into the game)
NPC gait: crowd stride and cadence from speed and height (feet plant), varied leg swing; near people animate every frame in view up to 60 m (was every 2nd-5th frame)
NPC pop-in: crowd fades (dithered, 0.5 s) in and out, far edge fades by distance, close spawns placed out of view, no mass despawn on fps dips; density up (crowd 240, near cap 40)
Shadow flicker: static map keeps its light direction between re-centers, bias tied to it, edge fade at map borders, map centered ahead of the camera
Street-name signs on their posts and readable from both sides (patch drops the old floating, mirrored corner blades)
Realistic fire: noise flame sheets, fireball, embers, dark smoke; car fires rare; pickup beams subtle and near-only
Fire checked inside the running game (burning wreck, explosion)
